title: Mobile App Development
description:
We build native-quality mobile apps for iOS and Android, from the first prototype through App Store and Play Store submission.

Every app is built with a maintainable codebase and a clear plan for what happens after launch — updates, monitoring, and iteration based on real user behavior.

processSteps.title: Discovery
processSteps.description: Defining core features and the platforms that matter most to your users.

processSteps.title: Design
processSteps.description: Native-feeling interfaces designed for touch, not adapted from desktop.

processSteps.title: Development
processSteps.description: Built and tested across real devices, not just simulators.

processSteps.title: Launch
processSteps.description: Store submission handled end-to-end, plus a plan for updates after launch.
